name: Primal Pulse
description: Strike with qi in its first unshaped state so the blow carries no style the foe can read.

name: Primal Veil
description: Hold a veil of unshaped qi that has no weak point because it has no shape to break.

name: Primal Current
description: Let the unshaped current run through yourself or an ally so every technique gains depth.

name: Primal Mend
description: Return an ally or yourself toward the shape of health with unshaped qi that remembers no wound.

name: Primal Tide
description: Send the unshaped tide across the ground to flatten everything that holds a shape.

name: Primal Weave
description: Weave the raw current round a foe so tightly that their own qi cannot form a technique.

name: Primal Recall
description: Pour the unshaped current into an ally whose breath just stopped and call them back within the short window.

name: Primal Purge
description: Strip every taint curse and binding from an ally by returning their qi to its clean first state.

name: Primal Crown
description: The school's crowning stroke: raw qi is gathered above the user and struck down over the front.

name: Primal Aegis
description: The school's crowning guard: raw qi is spread over the whole company and mends those beneath it.

name: Primal Ruin
description: Loose the whole unshaped reserve at the destructive ceiling of the tier and ruin all form within reach.

name: Prior to Shape
description: Return all qi in the field to its state before any technique was made; no energy mechanic explains how the shaped qi forgets.

name: Source Pulse
description: Strike with a pulse drawn straight from the source breath so it arrives before the foe's guard forms.

name: Source Veil
description: Hold a veil drawn from the source breath that is renewed faster than blows can wear it.

name: Source Thread
description: Follow a thread from the source breath to every living body in the field and read it.

name: Source Balm
description: Pour balm from the source breath into an ally or yourself until grave wounds seal.

name: Source Tide
description: Raise a tide from the source breath that sweeps the whole front and does not slacken.

name: Source Seal
description: Close a foe's qi off from the source and leave their techniques dry for a long while.

name: Source Renewal
description: Draw the source breath into an ally who has just fallen still and start their breath within the short window.

name: Source Wash
description: Wash an ally in the source breath and carry off curse taint binding and soul erosion together.

name: Source Crown
description: The school's crowning stroke: the source breath is brought down over the front and bows every foe in it.

name: Source Aegis
description: The school's crowning guard: the source breath is drawn round the company and mends it from within.

name: Source Unsealed
description: The school's crowning gift: the user opens the source fully and every strike of the user and allies lands harder.

name: Source Ruin
description: Let the source breath break upon the field at the destructive ceiling of the tier.

name: Unspent Breath
description: Take one breath from the source that is never spent; no energy mechanic explains why the user's reserve does not fall while it lasts.
